description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch; Single and two storey side to rear extension; Single storey rear extension; Rear dormer; Roof lights in front side and rear roof slopes (Demolition of conservatory; rear extension and detached garage to rear)
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: BIODIVERSITY CHECKLIST, Reasonable Exemption Statement, Bat Emergence Survey, Preliminary Bat Roost Assessment, Flood Risk Assessment: 4094/RE/03-26/01 REVISION A, 1628-001-PA, 1628-002-PA-REV SK1, 1628-003-PA- REV SK1, 1628-004-PA- REV SK1, 1628-005-PA- REV SK1, 1628-006-PL- REV SK2, 1628-007-PL- REV SK2, 1628-008-PL- REV SK2, 1628-009-PL- REV SK2, 1628-010-PL- REV SK2.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

Prior to the construction of any works above DPC level, a Biodiversity Enhancement Plan shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp; This shall include a scaled, colour plan of biodiversity
enhancements on the site, to include the number, specification, and location of
enhancements such as bat and bird boxes.&nbsp; Thereafter, the biodiversity
enhancement measures shall be carried out and retained in accordance with the
approved details.

<p>Prior to the
commencement, of the development hereby approved,&nbsp; the following details shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority</p><p>&nbsp;(a) details of permeable paving and a maintenance plan;&nbsp; &nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;(b)Full
construction details of the soakaway including its location, size, storage
volume and calculation; </p><p>(c) Detailed description of building materials, foundations, floor, walls,
fittings, services, doors and windows that minimise water entry whilst
maintaining structural integrity, materials and construction techniques that
facilitate drying and cleaning, in line with CLG 2007 'Improving the Flood
Performance of New Buildings'</p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and thereafter retained.</p><p><br></p>
